# Phase Contract Template

> Status: Draft  
> Owner:  
> Target window:  
> Dependencies:  

## Outcome

One sentence describing the user-visible and system outcome.

## Current verified state

Only facts proven by repository, production, or accepted evidence.

## Scope

Exact capabilities and affected domains.

## Non-goals

What must not be built or changed.

## Interfaces and data contracts

Routes, APIs, schemas, events, migrations, and external services.

## Implementation constraints

Security, compatibility, performance, design, and operational boundaries.

## Acceptance criteria

Executed, observable conditions.

## Required evidence

Browser, network, database, tests, recordings, or monitoring.

## Documentation updates

Files that must be updated on completion.

## Handoff

Branch, SHA, files, migrations, tests, risks, and next task.
